events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -3 e5fbf41 2>&1|head -3; git branch -r --contains e5fbf41 2>&1|head; git grep -n -i -E "slack|amazon|youtube" -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/book.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/hub-spoke.tsx app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/waterfall.tsx | cut -c1-200 | head -40; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/public/brand/logos/tools/{amazon,youtube}.svg; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4322/funnels/waterfall; git log --oneline -3 -- app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/waterfall.tsx | cut -c1-120; grep -n -o 'logos: \[[^]]*\]\|logo: "[a-z]*"\|Mark id="[a-z]*"' app/src/components/masterclass/funnel-os-types/waterfall.tsx | sort -u | head -20; git grep -n -i "team chat" app/src/components/masterclass | head

events.head: Verify logo ids exist and no Slack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for id in crm googleworkspace wistia dodo clarity resend ga4 stripe cloudflare metricool facebook instagram; do grep -q "^  $id:" src/components/masterclass/funnel-os.tsx && echo "ok $id" || echo "MISSING $id"; done | tr '\n' ' '; echo; git grep -n -i -w slack -- src/components/masterclass | cut -c1-160 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run funnel board probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 1,30p scripts/probe-funnel-boards.mjs | grep -n -i -E "width|argv|base|usage" | head; mkdir -p /tmp/t295b; (node scripts/probe-funnel-boards.mjs > /tmp/t295b/probe.txt 2>&1; echo exit $?) ; tail -5 /tmp/t295b/probe.txt; grep -c PASS /tmp/t295b/probe.txt; grep -c FAIL /tmp/t295b/probe.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe widths
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n -E "1440|1024|760|390|350|WIDTHS|VW" scripts/probe-funnel-boards.mjs | head; awk '{print $2}' /tmp/t295b/probe.txt | sort | uniq -c | head

events.text: The probe passes at all five widths. Next I'm taking 390 px screenshots and running probe-visual-tools.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Screenshot three pages at 390px and run tools probe

events.text: My crude DOM overlap heuristic is just catching container divs, so I'm checking the screenshots by eye.
The boards look dimmed, still in their intro state. I'm comparing with the earlier run's settled shot to see how it was triggered.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look at previous run's shot script
events.input: $ ls /tmp/t295/ 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls /tmp/t295/*.mjs 2>/dev/null && head -30 /tmp/t295/*.mjs | grep -n -E "scroll|click|wait|goto" | head

events.text: The animation is scroll-driven, so I'm re-running the scroll-based shot script with fresh output.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-run scroll-driven screenshot script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; f=$(grep -l "data-funnel-os" /tmp/t295/*.mjs | head -1); echo $f; sed 's#/tmp/t295/#/tmp/t295b/#g' $f > scripts/.t295f.mjs; grep -n -E "for|path" scripts/.t295f.mjs | head -8; node scripts/.t295f.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15; rm scripts/.t295f.mjs; ls /tmp/t295b/*.png | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scroll through boards at 390px checking text overlap

events.text: The checker flags the headline and the board sharing space. I'm looking at the frames to see whether that's real overlap or a layered backdrop.
Those frames are clean. The flagged hits are board content clipped under the header. Next I'm checking the late, end-state frames.

events.name: Bash
events.head: List frames flagged by overlap check
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t295b; for r in book-call waterfall hub-spoke; do echo "$r: $(ls ov-$r-*.png 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/.*-([0-9]+)\.png/\1/' | sort -n | tr '\n' ' ')"; done

events.text: The end-state frames are clean. Last visual check: whether the Amazon mark renders on /funnels/book.
